title: Common Types
description: Shared type definitions for PlanSpec schemas

duration.description: Duration in Go format (e.g., '30s', '5m', '1h30m'). Valid units: ns, us/µs, ms, s, m, h. No day unit.

labelKey.description: Kubernetes-style label key. Optional prefix (DNS subdomain) followed by '/', then name segment.

labelValue.description: Kubernetes-style label value. Alphanumeric with dashes, underscores, dots. Empty string allowed.

nodeId.description: Node identifier within a Plan graph. DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

uid.description: Opaque, server-assigned unique identifier. Survives renames and is stable for the lifetime of the resource. Not necessarily a UUID.

dnsLabel.description: DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, max 63 chars. Used for names, namespaces, and other identifiers.
